description.value: Silver Meadows Farm Market is a family-run farm market in Errington near Parksville on Vancouver Island, best known for its fresh corn and strawberries. It offers a range of locally grown produce, meat, eggs, baked goods, and handmade crafts, and hosts a seasonal corn maze that draws community interest. With nearly 9,500 Facebook followers and regular fresh-harvest posts, it is a well-regarded local food stop along the rural Vancouver Island cycling corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The Facebook page for Silver Meadows Farm Market Ltd. partially loaded across multiple subpages, providing the business intro ('fresh produce, meat, eggs, baked goods, and local hand made crafts'), a full address corroborating OSM, and a matching phone number. A post from 4 days ago ('Open 9:30-5:30 EVERYDAY Lots of Fresh Picked Produce!') confirms the business is currently active. No specific evidence was found for bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or any cycling-specific amenities beyond general grocery stock.

Facebook front page returned a technical error on fetch; usable content was recovered from subpages.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating farm market with recent social media activity and confirmed open status; a useful fresh-produce stop for touring cyclists on Vancouver Island.
